title: 미래국방전략위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
title_original: 미래국방전략위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 7 (Meetings)
(1) The chairperson shall convene meetings of the Committee and preside over them.
(2) A meeting shall open with the attendance of a majority of incumbent Committee members, and a resolution shall be adopted with the affirmative vote of a majority of the members present.
(3) Where the chairperson deems it necessary in connection with an agenda item submitted to a meeting, the head of a central administrative agency who is not a member of the Committee, the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, the Chief of Staff of each armed service, or the Commandant of the Marine Corps may attend the meeting and speak.
(4) Where necessary to deliberate on an agenda item, the chairperson may invite the heads of relevant administrative agencies, public institutions, other institutions or organizations, relevant public officials, or experts to a meeting to hear their opinions.
